kpis.description_fr: Net Bookings = mesure cash gaming (vs Revenue déféré). KPI clé industrie video games. Inclut full game + monétisation récurrente (MTX, season passes).
kpis.description_en: Net Bookings = cash gaming metric (vs deferred Revenue). Key video game industry KPI. Includes full game + recurring monetization (MTX, season passes).

kpis.description_fr: % du Net Bookings provenant de recurrent consumer spending (GTA Online, NBA 2K MyTEAM, Zynga mobile ads/IAP). Modèle moins cyclique que full game launches.
kpis.description_en: % of Net Bookings from recurrent consumer spending (GTA Online, NBA 2K MyTEAM, Zynga mobile ads/IAP). Less cyclical than full-game launches.

kpis.description_fr: Net Bookings Mobile (Zynga acquired mai 2022 pour 12,7 G$). Match Factory!, FarmVille, Words With Friends. Plateforme app store iOS/Android.
kpis.description_en: Mobile Net Bookings (Zynga acquired May 2022 for $12.7B). Match Factory!, FarmVille, Words With Friends. iOS/Android app store platform.

kpis.description_fr: Catalyseur structurel : lancement GTA VI prévu automne 2025 (T2 fiscal 2026). Premier trailer Dec 2023 = 90M+ vues 24h. Considéré le plus grand lancement de l'histoire du divertissement.
kpis.description_en: Structural catalyst: GTA VI launch slated for fall 2025 (T2 FY26). First trailer Dec 2023 = 90M+ views 24h. Considered the biggest entertainment launch in history.

kpis_story.description_fr: Lancement GTA VI prévu automne 2025. Estimations marché : 25+ M$ unités première année, $5+ Mds revenu lifetime. Catalyseur structurel TTWO.
kpis_story.description_en: GTA VI launch planned Fall 2025. Market estimates: 25M+ units year one, $5B+ lifetime revenue. Structural TTWO catalyst.

_notes: Take-Two : KPIs gaming distinctifs (Net Bookings vs Revenue, recurrent consumer spending %, mobile Zynga). Catalyseur GTA VI = pivot fiscal 2026.
